summary: async_status needs the job id (jid) and a mode of either status or cleanup, where cleanup removes the job's cache file in ~/.ansible_async without waiting.
questions: How do I clean up async job files in ~/.ansible_async?
What parameter identifies the async job?
Can I remove an async job's status file before it finishes?

answer_card.title: async_status parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `jid` (required): the job id (from `register` → `ansible_job_id`)
- `mode`: `status` (default) or `cleanup` (deletes the job cache in `~/.ansible_async/` without waiting)
